title: Adaptive-runtime implemented-factor onboarding
purpose: Onboard exactly two already-implemented adaptive-runtime factors into the versioned experiment-control contracts, produce externally reviewable correctness-only proof candidates, and enumerate their constrained planning space without performance measurement or broad multi-axis execution.
scope: The specification applies only to oversized_write_admission_quantum and queued_send_burst_budget, while preserving the existing batch/buffer chain, the completed no_stable_rule result, all retained schema versions, and the one-behavior-distinct-axis runtime boundary.

requirements.title: Reconcile completed send-composition state
requirements.statement: The repository MUST distinguish reviewed actuation proof, correctness eligibility, completed holdout extension, and runtime-rule promotion; retain measurement_completed_no_stable_rule as a completed non-promoting result; and keep active behavior authorization and performance acceptance false.

requirements.title: Audit and select exactly two implemented factors
requirements.statement: The checkpoint MUST audit oversized_write_admission_quantum, queued_send_burst_budget, and packet_flush_cadence from their production mechanism seams; select exactly the first two only when their authority and evidence path are bounded and truthful; classify relationships using the reviewed taxonomy; and defer the third axis with an exact reason rather than constructing an artificial family.

requirements.title: Additive canonical factor contracts
requirements.statement: The repository MUST preserve every existing v1, v2, and v3 artifact and add versioned axis, behavior, relationship, combination-constraint, and experiment-family contracts that canonically represent the two selected axes, their legal values, activation and distinctness predicates, mechanism-derived behaviors, safety clamps, fixed-axis requirements, and false active and measurement authorization.

requirements.title: Produce independent candidate actuation evidence
requirements.statement: Each newly onboarded behavior-distinct value MUST have an independent correctness-only candidate proof that binds an actual mechanism capture to plan, validation, manifest, run, host, binary, workload, exact operation evidence, catalog-owned behavior and outcome materializations, classifications, artifact inventory, metrics, and deterministic projection; proves activation, forcing, eligibility, application, safety fallback, shadow neutrality, rollback, and terminal correctness; and remains candidate with no passed review outcome.

requirements.title: Enumerate the constrained effective space
requirements.statement: The planning artifacts MUST deterministically enumerate every configured cell, apply canonical legality, capability, structural-inactivity, safety-clamp, and equivalence classifications, preserve shared-fallback values as distinct when their primary behavior signatures differ, emit explicit planned_cells, and prefer exhaustive enumeration when the behavior-distinct correctness space is no larger than 64 cells.

requirements.title: Preserve correctness-only and review boundaries
requirements.statement: The checkpoint MUST reject unknown or stale factor references, missing or ambiguous behavior derivation, unsupported tuples, false distinctness, self-approved proof candidates, active or measurement authorization, and arbitrary multi-axis execution; run focused regressions and builds; preserve unrelated failures; and finish without performance work, another-axis migration, CI modification, push, or active policy behavior.
